name: Quits
tagline: Quits is a privacy-preserving expense splitting application
blurb: Quits is a privacy-preserving, shared expense splitting application built with Kotlin Multiplatform.
description:
Quits is a privacy-preserving, shared expense splitting application built with Kotlin Multiplatform.
The app allows to easily split expenses between multiple people and synchronize via a public
or self-hosted, encrypted relay server.

It supports multiple groups, members, split types, categories, etc.
